Deactivate a lesson without deleting it

Source: R/mcp_memory.R
deactivate_lesson.Rd

Marks a lesson inactive so get_lessons() omits it unless include_superseded = TRUE. History is preserved (unlike delete_memory_record()).

Usage

deactivate_lesson(id)

Arguments

id

Lesson record id returned by record_lesson().

Value

A list with deactivated (logical) and id.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
enable_memory()
id <- record_lesson("obsolete note")$id
deactivate_lesson(id)
} # }
